params.body:
A Deliveries page for what plans promise customers: today the quarterly read Intelligence includes, on the category the customer chose on gentells.com (site and pipeline pull requests of the same day).

- One row per delivery: the customer and their members, the brief (category, question, contact, or "No brief yet" in red), the due date with how many days are left or how late it is, the owner and the state. A read nobody owns shows who it goes to when taken up. Delivered needs the link to the read before it can be saved.
- Delivered and missed reads of the last year below, then the category owners: a fallback and an owner per sector, changed by an admin.
- On an editor's bar, since editors write the reads. An admin finds it under System beside Accounts: one more item on the admin's bar broke it at 1280px (the header test caught it).

Merge after the site and pipeline pull requests.

Tests: `e2e/deliveries.spec.js` (open, late, no brief, delivered, taking a read up, the link required for delivered, the owners; the editor's bar and the admin's System menu). All 91 end-to-end tests pass; lint is clean on the changed files; the build is green.
params.title: Deliveries: what plans promise customers, and who writes it
